terms.definition: An animal that hunts, catches, and eats other animals.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the top hunters of the food chain.

terms.definition: A body feature or behavior that helps an animal survive.
terms.function: Gives predators an edge in hunting.
terms.whyItMatters: Better adaptations mean more successful hunting.

terms.definition: The way predators and prey keep each other's numbers in check.
terms.whyItMatters: It stops any one species from taking over.
